root: ^You alright? You look like something’s eating you.
^Huh? Oh, uh… It’s nothing. Just—forget it.
^Doesn’t seem like nothing. You look ready to burst.
^Alright, fine. The Mayor hired me to post some things online. You know, get people talking, stir the pot a little. Sounded harmless at first, but now… I don’t know. Feels wrong.
^What exactly did he ask you to post?

BobConfession: ^“Facts” about his opponent. Except I did some digging. Some of it’s… twisted. And some of it? Just flat-out lies, People are eating it up. No one even checks if it’s true. They just share it like it’s gospel.
^That’s not just shady—that’s harmful maligned information.Harmful maligned information spreads because it feeds emotions—fear, anger, outrage. People react first, think later.
^…Yeah. I don’t want to be part of that.
^Smart call. A few clicks might seem small, but lies can do real harm.

s: ^History has shown us that these promises often come with strings attached. Why would this time be any different?
^I hope so, but can we afford to take that risk when so many people are struggling?
^That’s exactly what they want you to think—to make you drop your guard.
^It’s worth hoping, but let’s make sure we’re not being misled.

LogicalTone: ^Yeah… I guess I should think twice before jumping into something just because it sounds good.
EmotionalTone: ^Yeah… that’s what’s really messing with me. People trust what they read, and I’m just making it worse, I need to do better. Thanks for the reality check.
ArgumentativeTone: ^You really think it’s that calculated?, Never thought about it like that. Guess I need to start paying more attention.
^That’s the only way to stay ahead of it.
ReservedTone: ^Yeah… blind trust never really worked out for anyone, I’ll keep that in mind. Thanks.
